complete.text: My name is Dana Whitlock. Mailing address 14 Juniper Lane, Sample Creek. Phone 555-0142, email dana@example.com. I am the owner of record of parcel SC-204-118 at 14 Juniper Lane, zoned R-1, which is 22,000 square feet (200 feet along Juniper Lane by 110 feet deep). I want to split it into two lots: Lot 1 would be 12,000 square feet with 109 feet of frontage on Juniper Lane, and Lot 2 would be 10,000 square feet with 91 feet of frontage on Juniper Lane. Each lot fronts directly on Juniper Lane, a public road. Both lots are inside the town water and sewer service area and will connect to town water and sewer. There is one house, on Lot 1; it will be 30 feet from the new lot line, 28 feet from the front line, 12 feet from the west side line and 40 feet from the rear line. I have attached my sketch. The legal description on my deed is Lot 7, Block 3, Juniper Heights Addition, Town of Sample Creek. No part of the parcel is in a mapped flood hazard area. I understand the $250 review fee is due when I file.

missing_parcel.text: I'm Ray Okafor, 88 Cedar Court, 555-0199. I own a one-acre lot on Cedar Court zoned R-2 and want to divide it into three lots of about 14,500 square feet each, each with 60 feet of frontage on Cedar Court. All three would hook up to town water and sewer. There are no buildings on it. I'll pay the $250 fee at filing and I am the only owner.
